# voipms_server (Data Source)

Looks up a VoIP.ms POP by id (`getServersInfo`). Use this to map `pop = 73` to `newyork7.voip.ms`.


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_server" "newyork7" {
  pop = "73"
}

output "hostname" {
  value = data.voipms_server.newyork7.hostname
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pop` (String) Point-of-presence id (`server_pop`).

### Read-Only

- `country` (String) Server country.
- `hostname` (String) SIP hostname (e.g. `newyork7.voip.ms`).
- `id` (String) Same as `pop`.
- `ip` (String) Server IP address.
- `name` (String) Server display name.
- `recommended` (Boolean) Whether VoIP.ms marks this POP as recommended.
- `shortname` (String) Short server name.
